portInfo.description: Portofino’s yacht marina (Comune-managed as Portofino Yacht Marina since March 2021) publishes a dedicated cruise-ship tender acceptance area next to Isolotto inside the harbour, separated by a moveable bulkhead. There is no alongside cruise terminal; passengers arrive by ship’s tender. The piazzetta sits at the water’s edge of the borgo.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Photograph last-tender time before leaving the pier.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: Piazzetta. Immediate from tender landing when in Portofino harbour. Castello Brown. Uphill path; minutes estimate 15–25 climb — not surveyed. Santa Margherita. Some ships tender there instead — verify landing on the day (not asserted as default here).
